about: GTA 6 checklist Short (Delta, CNS-style 'do these N things before X' format, our own list): four things to do before you get busted. Losses on arrest per Game Rant (Hamza Haq, 2026-11-20): pocket cash taken by the cops, stolen/unregistered weapons and vehicles gone, stash bags confiscated, personal vehicle may be impounded; GamesRadar+ (Josh West, 2026-11-19): unowned (looted) guns lost forever if Wasted or Busted, owned guns recoverable from the trunk or an Ammu-Nation locker, Pay 'n' Sprays register a car for a fee, impounded if busted while driving your personal vehicle, up to $20,000 pocket cash per character, all pocket cash lost if Wasted or Busted. PowerPyx/VGC: BuckMe account from the Chapter 1 mission Buck Me, deposit at any ATM. Conflict noted in BRIEF.md: PC Gamer says death/arrest costs 'a few hundred dollars'. Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.text: GTA 6: do these 4 before you get busted.
lines.say: G T A six. Do these four before you get busted.

lines.text: One: buy the gun you love.
Guns you loot are lost when you're busted.
Bought guns wait at Ammu-Nation or in your trunk.
lines.say: Bought guns wait at Ammu Nation, or in your trunk.

lines.text: Two: register your ride at a Pay 'n' Spray.
lines.say: Two: register your ride at a Pay and Spray.

lines.text: Stolen cars are gone after an arrest.
Three: get stash bags to the fence first.
But get busted in your own car? It's impounded. Buying it back costs you.
Four, the most important one: bank your cash.
You can carry $20,000. Guides say the cops keep all of it.
lines.say: You can carry twenty thousand dollars. Guides say the cops keep all of it.
So... how much are you carrying?
